title: Junk on the Moon and Mars: every human-made object on two worlds, mapped
excerpt: I mapped every human-made object on the Moon and Mars from Wikipedia's lists: 133 on the Moon and 27 on Mars, 203 tonnes and 10.4 tonnes. A third of the Moon's junk is five Saturn V rocket stages, and almost all of it is dead.
seo_description: A map of all 160 human-made objects on the Moon and Mars: landers, rovers, crashes, rocket stages, flags and golf balls.
header_alt: Title card reading 'Junk on the Moon and Mars' in red, black and rust on pale paper, beside two framed maps: a grey Moon scattered with coloured symbols for 133 objects, crowded in the middle of the near side, and an orange Mars with 27.
